articles.title: CDC expands largest known U.S. cyclospora outbreak to 9 states - The Washington Post
articles.description: The newly linked states — Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma and Pennsylvania — join Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio and West Virginia.
articles.content:
The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has linked fouradditional states to a multistate cyclosporiasis outbreak traced to shredded iceberg lettuce sourced from central Mexico.
